content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Program Manager/Research Associate: Graduate in life science/Para Medical Sciences/Bsc Nursing/BDS/BHMS/BAMS with one-year experience in health-related research project OR Post-graduation degree in life science/Paramedical Sciences/MPH/Msc/Msc Nursing etc. Desirable: Experience in data collection and compilation. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 19-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 19th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Program Manager/Research Associate and Field Investigator/Research Assistant in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the posts advertised by AIIMS Rishikesh?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 35 years. Age relaxation details, if any, will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As per the notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these positions at AIIMS Rishikesh?
faq.answer: The selection process for the advertised posts will involve a Written Exam followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Program Manager/Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate degree in life science/Para Medical Sciences/Bsc Nursing/BDS/BHMS/BAMS with one year of research experience, or a Post-graduation degree in relevant fields.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator/Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Field Investigator/Research Assistant post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 15,000.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for the AIIMS Rishikesh recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates are required to apply via email. They need to send their complete application along with all necessary documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all detailed information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of AIIMS Rishikesh?
faq.answer: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Rishikesh is located in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 249203.
